page.overview:
What is Abandoned Tower?

Abandoned Tower is located west of the village of Heatherton within Velen.

The tower is mostly inaccessible, but it is possible to climb up on a paraphet when attempting it from the northwestern corner. There are two chests at the top of the tower.

During Ciri's stay with the Bloody Baron in , they raced each other to this tower, where they awoke a powerful basilisk who was resting atop it.
